FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.Name: Hiking trail
FlowerPainter.Recipe.HikingTrail.Descrip: A trail that follows the land: contour paths and switchbacks on slopes, a trailhead with parking and a map board, rest spots, viewpoints and footbridges over water.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.landscape.Tool: Sets where the trail likes to run and what grows around it: forest, open meadow, along the ridge, down the canyon, or by the water.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.route.Tooltip: Loop back to the trailhead, a through trail to another entrance (or out and back to the far end), or up to the summit and down another way.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.maxGrade.Toolt: Steepest climb the trail should take. Lower values follow the contours and add switchbacks on slopes.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.wander.Tooltip: How much the trail meanders on easy ground.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.restSpacing.To: Distance between rest spots along the trail (bench facing the view, bin, picnic table). 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.viewpoints.Too: Viewing platforms with benches at the most prominent points along the trail.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.lookoutTower.T: Puts a lookout tower (or shelter) at the best viewpoint.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.picnicTables.T: A picnic table at every rest spot.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.waymarkers.Too: Distance between signposts along the trail. 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.trailheads.Too: Car park, map board and bench at the main entrance, at every entrance, or none.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.parking.Toolti: Marked car spaces at each trailhead (a gravel or asphalt pad beside the trail entry).
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.mapBoard.Toolt: A trail map or information board at the trailhead.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.bridges.Toolti: Lets the trail cross water on footbridges. Off: the trail goes around water.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.treeDensity.To: Trees per hectare (forest is 200 or more).
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.trailClear.Too: Distance kept free of trees on each side of the trail.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.clearings.Tool: Open clearings beside the trail, each with a bench. Camp and picnic features get their own.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.wornTrail.Tool: Paints worn ground along the trail (permanent).
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.shapeTerrain.T: Carves a gorge around the trail or raises a ridge under it, blended back to the ground at the outline (permanent). Auto: gorge for canyons, ridge for ridges.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.terrainDepth.T: How deep the gorge is or how high the ridge rises, in metres.
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.bridgeAsset.To: Path used for footbridges over water (automatic = a pedestrian bridge).
FlowerPainter.HikingTrail.Issue.NoRoute: Hiking trail: no route fits inside the area (too narrow, blocked or under water).
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TrailCamp.Name: Backcountry camp
FlowerPainter.AddOn.TrailCamp.shelter.To: A simple shelter at the edge of the camp.
